lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible. Spacing is non-uniform, with wider intervals (approx. 50-70 pixels) on the anterior torso narrowing to compressed intervals (approx. 20-30 pixels) on the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is located on the fourth vertical line from the anterior, splitting in the upper-mid quadrant of the torso and extending downward.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 6, 7, and 8 from the anterior exhibit mid-torso termination, failing to reach the ventral boundary and transitioning into segmented spot patterns.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense cluster of 6 high-contrast circular spots is located on the lateral-posterior haunch, arranged in a roughly triangular spatial grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots align in a semi-connected horizontal trajectory across the mid-thigh, creating a secondary geometric line parallel to the ventral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white dual-spot marking on the mid-bridge of the muzzle and a prominent white transverse crescent on the lower throat area.
